html:
The Schengen Agreement was signed on 14 June 1985 on a riverboat on the Moselle at Schengen, the Luxembourg village where Luxembourg, France and Germany meet.

Belgium, France, West Germany, Luxembourg and the Netherlands agreed to remove checks at their shared borders. The rules took effect in 1995. The Schengen Area now takes in most of the European Union and a few other countries, and hundreds of millions of people cross its inner borders without a passport check.

Free movement also meant shared control of the outer border and a common visa. That became a hard question in the migrant crisis of 2015, when several states brought back checks for a time.
sum: The Schengen Agreement was signed on 14 June 1985 on a riverboat on the Moselle at Schengen, the Luxembourg village where Luxembourg, France and Germany meet.
